subject.title: fix(codex): keep root memory in bootstrap context

question: Should native Codex expose root `MEMORY.md` through bounded turn context by default when memory tools are available, reversing the shipped tool-routed default from https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/pull/87383?
rationale: The patch is narrow and proof-backed, but it intentionally changes prompt visibility for user-editable memory and carries compatibility and security-boundary tradeoffs that automation should not accept for maintainers.

options.title: Accept Narrow Default Change
options.body: Merge this focused PR after owner review, keeping root `MEMORY.md` in bounded native Codex turn context while retaining memory tools for deeper recall.

options.title: Require Explicit Prompt Policy
options.body: Ask for a compatibility-preserving prompt-surface setting or another maintainer-approved policy surface before changing the default.

options.title: Keep Tool-Routed Default
options.body: Reject or pause this PR and keep root `MEMORY.md` tool-routed when memory tools are available.

recommendation.title: Accept Narrow Default Change
recommendation.body: Merge this focused PR after owner review, keeping root `MEMORY.md` in bounded native Codex turn context while retaining memory tools for deeper recall.

likelyOwner.reason: He introduced and merged the shipped memory-routing default that this PR revisits.
